title: Automatic Driving Exam Disqualification: Striking Curb/Cone, Rolling Stop, or Examiner Intervention

no_head_on_same_lane.note: No opposing vehicles facing each other in same lane; panels show single SUV and interior view only.

no_rhd_cabin.note: Right panel shows left-hand drive: driver on left seat with steering wheel on left, examiner/passenger reaching from right seat.

single_bulb_signal.note: Middle panel traffic signal shows two lit lenses: red on top and green on bottom illuminated simultaneously.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: Middle and right panels show double-yellow centerline on left of travel lane and white edge/curb on right; left close-up consistent.

zero_text.note: No letters, numbers or words; stop sign, plates are blank shapes; white X marks are simple graphic icons, not text.

scene_match.note: All three prompted errors present: left tire on knocked-down cone, center car past white stop bar, right examiner hand grabbing wheel.

result.summary: Scene matches three automatic failures but traffic signal illegally shows both red and green lit, requiring REJECT.

teaching_correct.note: Panels correctly illustrate disqualifying errors with red-X marking; car past stop bar and examiner intervention teach correct concept.

result.what_i_see: Three red-bordered panels with red-X badges show a blue SUV tire crushing a knocked-down orange cone on the left, the SUV beyond a white stop bar at a blank stop sign and traffic light in the center, and a passenger grabbing the wheel from the left-seat driver on the right.
